data.long_meaning: Nur means 'light' and Afsan means 'radiant'. The name Nurafshan means 'light of the radiant one'. The name Nurafshan carries the meaning “Light, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Nurafshan usually hope their child will grow to embody light, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nurafshan total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

The name is also associated with the concept of spiritual enlightenment, where an individual's inner light and beauty are revealed. In modern times, the name Nurafshan is used in various Muslim cultures to signify a person's connection to their faith and their pursuit of spiritual growth.
